{{Quote|The armadas of the Wives of Tingrippa sailed arrogantly between the Rim's beacons, boasting that their weapons could puncture any Republic hull and that their shields could soak up any Republic counterattack.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]], [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]]|<ref name="WarfareCut4">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
The '''Wives of Tingrippa''' were a [[Navy/Legends|naval force]] associated with the [[Waymancy Hollow]] in [[7811 BBY]]. During the [[Waymancy Storm]], Waymancy's religiously-motivated war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Pulse-wave cannon|pulse-wave weapons]] of the Wives of Tingrippa's ships were considerably more powerful than those of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], while efficient [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] meant that their [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] could absorb any Republic attack. This put the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] at an extreme disadvantage until it [[Sif-Alulan process|reverse-engineered]] Waymancy weapons and power generators captured at [[Sif-Alula]].
